name: Okasare Yuusha IV ~ANOTHER STORY~
source:
A world under control of the evil Empress. You vow to return freedom to the people by conquering the conquerors... but you are a mere and powerless human. 
With the help of Lilith, your succubus friend, and other recruited monster girls you are able to defeat the Empress... once. But it's a victory thanks to the enemy, and when the monster girls revolt you're set back to square one. 
The world remains under their control.

In your quest have learned about a human colony where monster girls "do various things" (wink) to the residents.
With the (ecchi) adventure behind you, days of lust follow... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133118.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个被邪恶女皇控制的世界。你发誓要通过征服征服者将自由还给人民……但你只是一个无能为力的人类。
在你的魅魔朋友莉莉丝和其他招募的怪物女孩的帮助下，你能够击败女皇……一次。但这是敌人的胜利，当怪物女孩反抗时，你又回到了原点。
世界仍然在他们的控制之下。

在你的探索中，你了解到了一个人类殖民地，那里的怪物女孩对居民“做各种事情”（眨眼）。
随着（ecchi）冒险的结束，欲望的日子随之而来…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133118.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
